title: Tomato Chutney
description: A tangy, slightly sweet chutney of tomatoes and onions cooked down with a touch of chana dal for body, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

ingredients.name: Tamarind
ingredients.notes: paste, or a small soaked piece

steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chana dal, urad dal and dried red chillies, frying until golden.
Add the chopped onion and ginger, and sauté until the onion softens.
Add the chopped tomatoes, turmeric and salt, and cook for 8-10 minutes until the tomatoes fully break down and turn pulpy.
Stir in the tamarind paste and cook for 2 more minutes. Let the mixture cool slightly, then blend to a coarse chutney.
For the tempering, heat the remaining oil in a small pan, add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over the chutney and mix well. Serve with idli, dosa or as a side with rice.
